overloads.semanticRole: The SELECT LIST ITEMS BY REFERENCE command selects the item(s) whose item reference number is passed in itemRef and, optionally, in refArray , within the list whose reference number is passed in list .

constraints: If there is no item with the given itemRef, the command does nothing.
Passing 0 in itemRef designates the last item added to the list.
If an item is not currently visible (in a collapsed sublist), the command expands the sublist(s) needed to make it visible.
When refArray is passed, itemRef additionally sets the new current item of the list among the resulting multi-selection (it may or may not belong to the set of items in refArray).
